name: @joeybuilt/nexalog-bridge
description: Proxies tool calls to Nexalog's data API for note, capture, bookmark, and memo operations.
author: Joeybuilt LLC

capabilitiesRationale.storage:read: Reads the Nexalog connection credentials (nexalog_user_id) to authenticate data API calls.

tools.name: nexalog.note.list
tools.description: List active notes across the user's Nexalog workspaces.

tools.name: nexalog.note.search
tools.description: Full-text search across note titles and content.

tools.name: nexalog.note.get
tools.description: Fetch the full content of a single note by ID.

tools.name: nexalog.note.create
tools.description: Create a new text note in the user's Nexalog workspace.

tools.name: nexalog.note.update
tools.description: Update the title or content of an existing note.

tools.name: nexalog.note.delete
tools.description: Soft-delete a note by ID.

tools.name: nexalog.bookmark.list
tools.description: List saved URL bookmarks in the user's Nexalog workspace.

tools.name: nexalog.bookmark.get
tools.description: Fetch the full details of a single bookmark by ID.

tools.name: nexalog.bookmark.add
tools.description: Save a URL as a bookmark in the user's Nexalog workspace.

tools.name: nexalog.bookmark.update
tools.description: Update the URL or title of an existing bookmark.

tools.name: nexalog.bookmark.delete
tools.description: Delete a saved bookmark by ID.

tools.name: nexalog.bookmark.tags.list
tools.description: List all bookmark tags in the user's Nexalog workspace.

tools.name: nexalog.bookmark.tag.create
tools.description: Create a new bookmark tag in the user's Nexalog workspace.

tools.name: nexalog.bookmark.tag.assign
tools.description: Assign a tag to a bookmark.

tools.name: nexalog.bookmark.tag.remove
tools.description: Remove a tag from a bookmark.

tools.name: nexalog.memo.create
tools.description: Save a voice memo transcript as a note in the user's Nexalog workspace.

tools.name: nexalog.capture.list
tools.description: List capture sources (raw inbox of links and snippets).

tools.name: nexalog.capture.get
tools.description: Fetch full details of a single capture source by ID.

tools.name: nexalog.capture.create
tools.description: Create a new capture source (link, snippet) in the user's Nexalog workspace.

tools.name: nexalog.capture.update
tools.description: Update the state or content of a capture source.

tools.name: nexalog.capture.delete
tools.description: Delete a capture source by ID.

tools.name: nexalog.claude.import_conversation
tools.description: Import a single Claude conversation as a Nexalog note, preserving full message history, model, timestamps, and artifacts.

tools.name: nexalog.claude.import_export
tools.description: Batch-import a Claude data export (conversations.json + projects.json) into Nexalog notes. Call repeatedly with offset to process all conversations.
